Follow-up to FR-1 (object-record sharing).

Built today: grantee leave-share/self-revocation (`POST /share/grants/:id/leave`) and a narrow read cascade from an object grant to derived primitives keyed by that record id: streams whose `streamId` equals the granted record id and projection rows whose subscribe/read `key` equals the record id. Object subscription snapshots/deltas are also filtered per record.

Remaining gaps: cascade scoping does not cover child records, blobs, jobs, search results, arbitrary app routes, or richer collaborator/product semantics. Authz coverage for the remaining cascade surfaces is still tracked by the open child stories.

Target: complete the remaining share-derived visibility surfaces without broadening tenant boundaries or relaxing write access unexpectedly.
